title: Crafting-Ritual
description: Crafting-Ritual  is the perfect synergy between copper, steam, high-tech progress and ancient magic.
body:
Crafting-Ritual  is the perfect synergy between copper, steam, high-tech progress, and ancient magic.

Begin your journey with Crafting, mastering the kinetic engineering of the Create mod. Build gigantic steam engines, automated conveyors, and rail systems to process resources. Use the fruits of your industry to power the high-tech systems of Mekanism and create the versatile logistics of Applied Energistics 2.

Then dive into Ritual. Channel the power of your factory to automate mystical processes: create endless mana sources with Botania and construct altars to cast your own spells in Ars Nouveau.

In this world, Technology fuels Magic, and Magic improves Technology. A meticulously tuned world awaits, enhanced with shaders and optimization for complete immersion. This is a build for engineers who believe in magic. 1.20.1 Forge 47.4.0
